Product:{\"sku\":\"7100141464\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Command modern land, sea, and air weapons across hex battlefields in 4-faction turn-based warfare. Issue orders to manufacture units, move, attack, and capture bases to seize enemy capitals.

Nation-specific arsenals (USA, Russia, Japan) form ""Production Types,"" expandable via DLC. Battles span 5 altitude tiers (High Air, Low Air, Ground, Surface, Subsurface) shaped by War Funds, Fuel Reserves, Industrial Power, terrain, recon, detailed specs, and Loadout Swaps. Features 58 Free Maps, global Scenario Maps via free updates, and 300+ units—including tanks, fighters, attack helicopters, ships, and submarines.

Season 2 adds ""Tech Power"" to unlock weapons in stages, plus the F-3, Anti-Tank Infantry, and Towed Howitzer. Select from 3 difficulty levels (Mock Battle, Real Combat, Fierce Battle), set starting resources, and enjoy added depth with Unit Insignia, Clear Icons, and the Weapons Collection.

Please Note Before Purchasing
- This product is the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version. It is a separate product from the Nintendo Switch™ version of Daisenryaku SSB 2.
Save Data and Downloadable Content are not compatible between the two versions. There is also no Upgrade Pack from the Nintendo Switch version to the Nintendo Switch 2 version. Please take care to avoid mistaken or duplicate purchases.
- The following bundle products containing the Base Game and Downloadable Content are also available. Please check what is included before purchasing to avoid duplicate purchases.
- ""Daisenryaku SSB 2 Power-Up Edition""
- ""Daisenryaku SSB 2 Ultimate EX Edition""
